title: ignite-bridge-weekly-agenda-meera-scratchpad
content:
Context: quick weekly for cross-subsystem alignment (serving runtime, infra, console). Personal prep notes / questions to surface. Keep it short (30m).

Goals for this week:
- unblock canary rollout for model-v2 on dedicated pool (verify KV cache warmup)
- decide autoscale vertical/threshold tweak for p99 latency spikes
- agree on console rollout hooks for fallback policy visibility

Agenda (30 min total):
1) 3m - Quick status + one-line wins (who: all)
2) 8m - Canary rollout status (who: Jonas/Ravi)
   - key metric snapshot: error-rate, p50/p95/p99, token/sec
   - open: cache warmup still cold for long-seqs? hypothesis: warmup window too short -> propose extend by 30s
3) 8m - Autoscale & infra ops (who: Hannah/infra)
   - note: observed backpressure when burst > 200 req/s; current policy: scale-per-gpu util@0.72
   - decision needed: temporary raise target to 0.78 for next 48h to smooth tail
4) 6m - Console/observability hooks (who: meera/console)
   - proposal: add "fallback_reason" to route-level traces + expose in UI
   - UX question: show as banner or insights panel? quick strawpoll
5) 5m - Action items + blockers (who: all)

Prep to bring:
- Jonas: latest canary logs, KV hit-rate chart, PR link to canary config
- Hannah: infra scaling traces and cost delta estimate for temp change
- Meera: mockup of fallback_reason UI and short list of required fields

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize safety: temp scaling param is reversible; add a guard to auto-revert after 48h unless ack by SRE
- If KV warmup hypothesis wrong, fallback: add prefix-caching for long sequences (cost tradeoff)
- Console change: keep field minimal (code + brief msg) to avoid noise

Open questions / follow-ups to track:
- Who owns automated revert? -> assign SRE on-call? (suggested: Ravi)
- Do we need infra budget approval for scaling tweak? -> if cost > $600/day, escalate to finance
- UX: banner vs panel? prefer panel; check with product-design (quick ping to Aliya)

Action items (live tracker) - initial entries:
- Jonas: post canary log digest + KV hit-rate CSV to this doc (due: 2026-03-15)
- Hannah: run 24h temp scale test in staging and report cost delta (due: 2026-03-16)
- Meera: add fallback_reason stub to traces schema PR (branch: trace/fallback-reason) (due: 2026-03-14)
- Ravi: prepare revert automation playbook + small runbook snippet for on-call (due: 2026-03-17)

Quick risks: if we raise scale target and demand drops, spend increases — mitigate by tight revert guard + alerting.

Post-meeting: copy action items to JIRA epic and assign owners. Quick 1:1 with Jonas after meeting if canary still flaky (10m).

Scratchpad end.

Random notes to self: remember to attach the PR link and the small flame graph for p99 before sending notes out.
